verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships its own programmatic surfaces: a Python API that the README describes as "full automation and customization," covering custom status bar components, triggers, menu items and new features. It also has AppleScript support for launching the app and opening sessions with profiles in tabs or windows, and a community user confirms the Python API works well in practice. However, no evidence shows that every UI capability (search, selection, paste history, instant replay, settings, AI chat, browser profiles) is reachable through the API, so UI parity is claimed in broad terms rather than demonstrated. missing for 10: documented API-to-UI parity coverage, API reference showing coverage of specific UI features such as settings, find, selection and paste history, independent confirmation that nothing is UI-only.
